completion_scope: Saved functional acceptance campaign settled; not a claim that every method, material, or advertised feature passed live validation.

source_identity.note: Current hashes identify this export. Changed modules need separate recheck receipts; original jobs were not rerun.

scope: Feature evidence snapshot. No model calls,SSH,submissions or product edits performed by this audit.

features.feature: CIF/POSCAR import, ordered periodic structure validation
features.claim: CIF/POSCAR inputs are parsed and checked for ordered, finite, non-overlapping periodic structures.

features.feature: Structure generation from chemical formula / arbitrary new material
features.claim: A source crystal is required. Formula-only crystal/phase invention is not supported.

features.feature: Cluster init, config, doctor, SSH/password, Slurm environment
features.claim: Cluster configuration and doctor checks have local tests and recorded Paracloud/Arrhenius connection evidence.
limits: This does not establish compatibility with every Slurm site or VASP installation.

features.feature: Manual preparation and explicit submission gate
features.claim: Preparation and submission remain separate reviewed actions in UI and CLI.
Codex interprets goals, guidance and preserved conversation constraints in finite live acceptance cases.
limits: Finite acceptance examples are not a universal intent-understanding success rate.

features.claim: Responses structured-output adapter, limits and usage normalization pass mocked SDK tests.
limits: No current live Responses-provider receipt. Codex results do not verify this adapter.

features.claim: Chat Completions structured-output adapter, limits and usage normalization pass mocked SDK tests.
limits: No current live compatible Chat Completions-provider receipt.

features.claim: Clarifications, revisions, exclusions and stale-source refusal are tested; long revised constraints also passed live Codex checks.
Unsupported calculations/methods are explicitly rejected; geometry edits are routed to the structure editor.
limits: Current phonon/NEB rejection is covered offline; do not present the structure-lattice live refusal as a live NEB run.

features.claim: Local method guidance keeps source links and is included without changing explicit user choices.

features.feature: Scoped past-run experience / rejected output exclusion
features.claim: Past-run retrieval filters method/source/geometry mismatches and preserves negative evidence; large advisory vectors are references, not copied parameters.
Representative PBE relaxation, SCF and bands completed with independently audited outputs.
Representative PBE DOS completed with exported data and independent checks.
MgO variable-cell relaxation completed; cell setting/outputs are independently checked.
limits: One small strained MgO case, not a general cell-convergence validation.

features.claim: Relaxed structure, site order and Cartesian-frame handoff have invariant tests and audited live propagation.
Representative collinear Fe/NiO calculations and local moments are checked.
limits: Initial FM/AFM seeds do not establish a magnetic ground state.

features.claim: The shared-cell Fe NM/FM/AFM comparison completed with independently audited stages; ranking also has current offline checks.
limits: This compares three specified seeds; it is not an exhaustive magnetic search or proof of the magnetic ground state.

features.claim: Noncollinear Fe without SOC completed through relaxation,SCF,bands,DOS.
Noncollinear SOC with nondefault SAXIS completed through all four tasks.
Si SOC initialized from explicit zero vectors completed through all four tasks.
limits: Zero initial moments do not impose constrained nonmagnetism.

features.claim: Explicit Dudarev U/J parameters are preserved; representative NiO +U completed through all four tasks.
SOC +U representative chain stages are tracked separately; only independently audited completed stages count as accepted.
Noncollinear +U without SOC completed in the NiO SCF probe.
limits: SCF probe only; no claim for its relaxation/bands/DOS Cartesian product.

features.claim: Nonmagnetic HSE06 Si completed through all four tasks.
Nonmagnetic PBE0 Si completed through all four tasks.
Magnetic hybrid workflows have fresh cluster evidence tracked per stage; pending branches remain unverified.
limits: Do not label queued/planned spectra or PBE0 stages as completed.

features.feature: Hybrid + SOC and Hybrid + SOC + U
features.claim: Hybrid+SOC and hybrid+SOC+U probes have accepted, rejected and pending stages tracked separately.
limits: SCF capability probes do not prove all hybrid/SOC/U combinations or task sequences. A numerically converged stage rejected by method checks is not accepted.

features.feature: Bands/DOS CSV, plots, energy references, hybrid equal-k gate
features.claim: Bands/DOS exports, energy references and hybrid equal-k checks have current tests and representative live artifacts.

features.feature: Background worker, progress, status and browser closure
features.claim: Stateful workers progress independent of UI; refresh does not submit calculations.
limits: Fresh control demonstrates process restart; no separate recorded manual browser-close experiment.

features.claim: A fresh process recovered the original scheduler job receipt without duplicate submission.
Cancellation of the same active/paused scheduler job was confirmed.

features.feature: Lost reply, UNKNOWN state, failed transfer handling
features.claim: Lost reply and transport/poll failures preserve identity and bound retries; negative branches are tested.
The current installed wheel produced a grounded explanation after edited-Si5Ge relaxation/SCF; follow-up UI and changed-context behavior also pass offline checks.
limits: One fresh installed live explanation plus retained historical cases; not every question or material is established.

features.claim: Changed result/source identity invalidates old answers and history.
limits: Test fixtures are deliberately changed; scientific originals were not edited.

features.claim: A fresh NELM1 failure produced a reviewed NELM120 child that succeeded, preserving parent/input identity.
A fresh ionic failure produced a reviewed accepted child with preserved input/parent identity.
limits: Representative control,not a guarantee that every failed calculation can be repaired.

features.claim: A fresh walltime failure produced a reviewed accepted child with preserved input/parent identity.
limits: Representative control,not a guarantee that every failed calculation can be repaired.

features.feature: Repair bounds, source preservation, unsupported failure refusal
features.claim: Repair bounds, parent preservation, method settings and unsupported-failure refusal are tested.
limits: Fresh end-to-end accepted repair controls: electronic, ionic, walltime. Other branches remain scoped to the cited tests.

features.claim: Advanced-method repair preserves source/order/SOC/U/hybrid settings in targeted fixture tests.
limits: This does not establish live repair success for every advanced method; GaFe2O4 failure is negative evidence, not accepted repair.

features.feature: Result ZIP, licensed-file exclusion, saved plans/dialogue/repair
features.claim: Bundles preserve reviewed plans, dialogue and structure provenance while excluding licensed wavefunction/potential files.
limits: Fresh installed-wheel bundle verification covers edited Si5Ge and its result/provenance records.

features.claim: The installed0.3.0 wheel passed reviewed two-turn structure editing,CLI preparation,Arrhenius relaxation/SCF,grounded explanation and bundle checks outside the checkout.
limits: One edited Si5Ge case, not validation of every installed method/material.

features.claim: All 488 local tests passed. GitHub CI for the same Python sources and tests passed on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13, including package installation.
limits: Recorded CI source identity is verified by file hashes; final release publication is checked separately.

features.claim: Public release/default-branch/asset availability must be verified after publication.
limits: Local tests, artifacts and candidate wheel are not a published release.

features.claim: Seventeen packaged examples import/prepare offline. Diverse fresh cluster example outcomes are tracked separately.
limits: The original GaFe2O4 run reached NELM without convergence and is not accepted. Consult each run state for later outcomes. Source files are not universal scientific references.

features.claim: Diagonal and general integer supercell matrices preserve source geometry/site provenance.
limits: Live dialogue covered diagonal repeat revisions; general matrices have offline geometry tests.

features.claim: Whole-species and selected-site substitutions preserve ordering and source indices.
limits: Live substitution used a specified Si site; substitution energetics were not established.

features.claim: Vacancies remove explicit sites after ordered preceding operations; revisions replace the earlier site choice.
limits: Defect formation energies and arbitrary defect searches remain outside scope.

features.claim: Cartesian/fractional site translations preserve nonorthogonal-cell semantics.
Explicit fractional-coordinate edits are validated; a revision replaces the previous coordinate.
Slabs require orientation,thickness,vacuum and an explicit choice when terminations are ambiguous.
limits: Generated slabs are unrelaxed geometric models; stability,polarity and surface convergence are not proven.

features.claim: CIF↔POSCAR conversion needs no model/cluster call and preserves cell metrics and site order through checked exports.
limits: CIF preserves cell metrics/fractional geometry, not an arbitrary Cartesian frame.

features.claim: Structure revisions replay the complete operation list once against the original upload, including CLI--previous.
Applying structure edits requires matching source and preview hashes; bundles retain provenance.

features.feature: Clear stale calculation state after edits
features.claim: Using edited geometry clears stale calculation drafts and magnetic moments.
CLI calculation--previous preserves original goal/history and rejects a changed source.
limits: New current CLI revision path is tested with mocked provider; no separate real CLI continuation call yet.

features.claim: UI retains constraints beyond six rounds for calculations,structures and explanations; helpers preserve all user turns.
limits: UI is exercised by Streamlit AppTest with provider doubles; the long-revision paired Codex case verifies backend semantics separately.

features.claim: Per-call provider token counts and latency are saved across planner,structure,explanation and repair outputs.
limits: Live Codex counts verified. Responses/chat field normalization is mocked SDK evidence. Missing counts stay unknown; cached/reasoning counts are subsets.

features.claim: Compact prompts preserve complete geometry and user constraints; advisory large vectors remain available in saved reports.
limits: Three single paired samples establish their measured counts and semantics,not typical savings or latency.

features.claim: A96,000-byte UTF-8 compact payload admission bound rejects oversize requests before invoking the provider.
limits: Bytes and characters are not token estimates. No truncation is used to admit the request.

features.claim: API output budgets are finite/configurable,scale for sites,and reject incomplete or length-limited responses.
limits: API-provider limit behavior tested with SDK doubles. Codex retains its own output budget.

features.claim: Refreshing plan,result or repair views reuses saved usage/results without another model request.
limits: Streamlit AppTest verifies call counts across reruns.

features.claim: Failed model calls retain measurable usage across refresh without replacing accepted evidence.
Arrhenius can reuse an explicitly configured SSH master for SSH/SCP without closing the user master.
limits: Specific authenticated Arrhenius session verified,not a general remote-login guarantee.

features.claim: Only explicit planning/explanation/repair requests call the model; observation and preparation/submission gates stay separate.
